description: This is a Java test class for the ExternalDictionaryFactory component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of dictionary override keys, default dictionary loading, keyboard-specific dictionary builders, and handling of unknown locales.

classes.name: ExternalDictionaryFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ExternalDictionaryFactory, testing dictionary override keys, default loading, locale-specific builders, keyboard-specific builders, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ExternalDictionaryFactory instance before each test.

methods.name: testPrefKey
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the override dictionary preference key logic.

methods.name: testDefault
methods.description: Checks the default enabled add-ons and their properties.

methods.name: testGetByLocale
methods.description: Tests retrieval of dictionary builders by locale.

methods.name: testBuildersForKeyboardHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies correct behavior of getting and setting dictionary builders for a keyboard.

methods.name: testEmptyBuildersForKeyboardIfUnknownLocale
methods.description: Ensures no builders are returned for an unknown locale.

methods.name: testOverrideBuildersForKeyboardHappyPath
methods.description: Tests overriding dictionary builders for a keyboard.

methods.name: testOverrideWhenDictionaryUnknown
methods.description: Checks behavior when an override dictionary is set to an unknown value.

methods.name: testCanNotSetEnabled
methods.description: Ensures that setting add-on enabled state throws an exception.
